C0935.title: Duxiaoman Assists Police in Dismantling a Major 'Anti-Collection' Fraud Ring
C0935.summary: Related reporting on December 26, 2023 showed that Mashang Consumer Finance, together with AIF alliance members Du Xiaoman and Meituan Finance, assisted police in cracking down on a large anti-collection fraud gang. Police controlled 67 people, and 41 suspects were subjected to criminal coercive measures on suspicion of fraud and forging seals. The case illustrates the importance of financial institutions cooperating with law enforcement to govern black and gray markets around anti-collection, proxy rights protection, and debt optimization.
